tagline: Aluminium and glass, made to measure

seo.title: Glass Right | Aluminium Windows, Doors & Glazing in Gauteng
seo.description: Made-to-measure aluminium windows, doors, shopfronts, balustrades and carports across Gauteng. Get an instant quote online.

hero.headline: Windows and doors, made to measure and fitted right.
hero.lead: From a single sliding window to a full shopfront, we manufacture and install quality aluminium and glazing across Johannesburg, Pretoria and the East Rand. Get a price in under a minute.

services.heading: One team for the whole job
services.intro: We manufacture in our own workshop, so you get the right fit, honest pricing and one person to call.

items.title: Windows
items.text: Sliding, casement and fixed windows in powder-coated or anodised aluminium, single or double glazed.

items.title: Doors
items.text: Stacking, sliding and hinged doors, from patio entrances to secure front doors.

items.title: Shopfronts
items.text: Strong, good-looking frontages for shops, offices and restaurants, installed with minimal disruption.

items.title: Balustrades
items.text: Aluminium and glass balustrades for stairs, balconies and pool areas, built to safety standards.

items.title: Carports
items.text: Neat, durable aluminium carports and covers designed to suit your home and your budget.

items.title: Glass & repairs
items.text: Replacement panes, new seals and rollers, and quick call-outs for broken glass.

stepsHeading: From first click to finished install

steps.title: Get your estimate
steps.text: Enter your sizes in our online quote tool and see a price range straight away, day or night.

steps.title: We measure on site
steps.text: A consultant visits, measures properly and confirms your final quote in writing. No obligation.

steps.title: Made and fitted
steps.text: We build to your measurements in our workshop and our own installers fit everything cleanly.

quote.heading: Know your price before you pick up the phone
quote.intro: Choose your product, enter the size and finish, and get an estimate in seconds. Leave your number and a consultant will call to confirm.
bullets: Prices based on current Gauteng rates
